intermediate_plane_design.curvature: Shallow-W spanwise crown: raised center apex, a soft valley around 60% span (dip factor 0.5) and tips lifted to the endplate mid-height with zero slope, so the arms meet the endplates almost horizontally.
intermediate_plane_design.attachment: Each endpoint profile is projected onto the endplate inner walls at the final raised pose with a 0.2 mm numerical inset, so the tips stay connected to the endplates (measured tip gap 0.2 mm, span 0.405889) and join them at mid-height (tip center z ~0.097) almost horizontally. Closed end caps remain inside the boundary. The single swan-neck is shortened (vertical scale 0.594192 over its floor base) and its rear arm is seated on the intermediate plane top: the union run (x 2.209-2.279) is conformed to the top surface with a progressive bite up to 10 mm and the arch is left clear of the plane.
